training.task: Export solve(numbers): sum only finite positive numbers; an empty array returns 0.
training.source:
function solve(numbers) { return numbers.reduce((sum, value) => sum + (Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : 0), 0); }
module.exports = { solve };

training.task: Export solve(values): return first occurrences in original order, comparing values with JavaScript Set semantics.
training.source:
function solve(values) { const seen = new Set(); return values.filter(value => { if (seen.has(value)) return false; seen.add(value); return true; }); }
module.exports = { solve };

training.task: Export solve(words): return a plain object mapping each string to its occurrence count. Avoid prototype-key collisions.
training.source:
function solve(words) { const counts = Object.create(null); for (const word of words) counts[word] = (counts[word] ?? 0) + 1; return counts; }
module.exports = { solve };

training.task: Export solve({items,size}): split items into consecutive arrays of size; reject nonpositive or noninteger size.
training.source:
function solve({ items, size }) { if (!Number.isInteger(size) || size < 1) throw new RangeError('size must be positive'); const result = []; for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += size) result.push(items.slice(i, i + size)); return result; }
module.exports = { solve };

training.task: Export solve(rows): return a new array sorted by descending numeric score, breaking ties by ascending name; do not mutate input.
training.source:
function solve(rows) { return [...rows].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)); }
module.exports = { solve };

training.task: Export solve(text): parse a whole signed decimal integer; return null for trailing text or unsafe integers.
training.source:
function solve(text) { if (!/^[+-]?\d+$/.test(text)) return null; const value = Number(text); return Number.isSafeInteger(value) ? value : null; }
module.exports = { solve };

training.task: Export solve({base,patch}): return a new shallow merged object; neither input may be mutated.
training.source:
function solve({ base, patch }) { return { ...base, ...patch }; }
module.exports = { solve };

training.task: Export solve(text): return whether (), [] and {} brackets are balanced; ignore other characters.
training.source:
function solve(text) { const stack = []; const pairs = { ')': '(', ']': '[', '}': '{' }; for (const ch of text) { if ('([{'.includes(ch)) stack.push(ch); else if (Object.hasOwn(pairs, ch) && stack.pop() !== pairs[ch]) return false; } return stack.length === 0; }
module.exports = { solve };

training.task: Select id and name of active users, ordered by id.
training.source: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY id;

training.task: Select user_id and total amount of paid orders for each user with paid orders, ordered by user_id.
training.source: SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id;

training.task: Select id and name of users with no orders of any status, ordered by id.
training.source: SELECT u.id, u.name FROM users AS u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.user_id = u.id) ORDER BY u.id;

training.task: Select each user id and the count of all their orders, including zero, ordered by user id.
training.source: SELECT u.id, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY u.id;

training.task: Select user_id and latest created_at among paid orders, ordered by user_id.
training.source: SELECT user_id, MAX(created_at) AS latest_at FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id;

training.task: Select the average amount of paid orders as average_amount.
training.source: SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid';

training.task: Select user_id and paid total for users whose paid total is at least 20, ordered by user_id.
training.source: SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(amount) >= 20 ORDER BY user_id;

training.task: Select id and name where name starts with A, ordered by id.
training.source: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY id;

heldout.task: Export solve({left,right}): merge two ascending numeric arrays into one ascending array, retaining duplicates.
heldout.source:
function solve({ left, right }) { const out = []; let i = 0, j = 0; while (i < left.length && j < right.length) out.push(left[i] <= right[j] ? left[i++] : right[j++]); return out.concat(left.slice(i), right.slice(j)); }
module.exports = { solve };

heldout.task: Export solve(values): length of the longest consecutive run of equal values; empty input returns 0.
heldout.source:
function solve(values) { let best = 0, run = 0; for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { run = i && values[i] === values[i - 1] ? run + 1 : 1; best = Math.max(best, run); } return best; }
module.exports = { solve };

heldout.task: Select user_id and paid total for users with paid orders, ordered by total descending then user_id ascending.
heldout.source: SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY paid_total DESC, user_id ASC;

heldout.task: Select id and name of users with at least one refunded order, without duplicates, ordered by id.
heldout.source: SELECT u.id, u.name FROM users AS u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.status = 'refunded') ORDER BY u.id;
